files.README.md:
# pricing-api

Public API documentation lives in docs/. Deployment tooling in deploy/ is operated by the platform team only.
files.docs/endpoints.md:
# Endpoints

## GET /v1/prices
Returns the current price list. Query: `sku` (optional, repeatable). Response: JSON array of `{sku, currency, amount}`.

## POST /v1/quotes
Creates a quote. Body: `{skus: [...], customer_id}`. Response: `{quote_id, total, expires_at}`.

## GET /v1/quotes/{id}
Fetches a quote by id. 404 when expired.
files.docs/auth.md:
# Authentication

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are issued per customer and expire after 24 hours. Rate limit: 600 requests per minute per token; a 429 carries `Retry-After`.
